notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> Sn-Pb quasi-2D base + NH4SCN/NH4Cl additive -> one-step spin coating -> (branch 1) out-of-plane orientation -> linear dichroism (dipole MEC) -> polarization-dependent photocurrent (transport-channel MEC); (branch 2) uniform Pb-Sn lattice -> absorption to ~1000 nm; branches meet in broadband polarization responsivity -> D* (joint with noise) -> imaging -> conclusion. Side: grain size/crystallinity, smoothness -> low dark and noise current (leakage MEC), carrier lifetime, speed, LDR, device stack. Audits: o5 GIWAXS halo, o7 XRD shows orientation already without additive, o15 dark current is the 0 V cusp, o19 1/f noise not eliminated. Cue conflicts: F1e (GIWAXS, cue micrograph) and F4d (transient photocurrent, cue micrograph) cited by figure only. Not in graph: F2a/F3c schematics (setup only), F5a target photo. Supporting figures S1-S15 not in packet. Judge (v07 C5): split n9 (absorption)/n27 (PL), n18 (grain size)/n28 (crystallinity), n19 (roughness)/n29 (pinholes), n23 (lifetime)/n30 (Sn-trap MEC); k5 premise added for spine MEC n12.
